sections_target.text: This document sets out the P1 maintenance procedures to be carried out annually, as indicated above by the code Y1. The first draft was prepared from the documents previously prepared by the Holding Company for Electric Power Distribution, and the document was discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies at the session of 17 March 2009

This maintenance is carried out to restore the efficiency of the transformer kiosk equipment to its normal condition; it is performed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, if any, taking operating conditions into account, and replacing and renewing the kiosk/room components that need replacement, in order to avoid sudden faults

rows: Issue an approved work permit and work order; maintenance staff must carry the occupational safety and health category card
Make sure the site is fenced off to define the work area and that warning signs are posted
It is essential to follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, wearing the helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Make sure there is no voltage from the supply source, using a voltage indicator
Make sure the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources
Make sure there is no voltage on the cable disconnect switches
Make sure the kiosk is isolated from all supply sources
Make sure portable earths are applied to the kiosk/room components to be worked on, after making sure there is no back-fed voltage on them
Make sure the capacitor switch is opened and wait 15 minutes for low voltage until the charge is discharged; for medium voltage make sure the charge is discharged

sections_target.text: A suitable set of tools and screwdrivers fit for use
Occupational safety and health equipment (PPE) such as the helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Tested voltage indicator, set of local earths
Blower, cleaning brush and pieces of soft, clean cloth
Paint material for painting the kiosk
Spare lighting lamps, emergency torch, lighting machine

rows: Switch off the automatic fire-fighting operating system
Carry out a comprehensive review of the kiosk/room to make sure the earthing connections are sound and that the kiosk and room are earthed
Make sure all connection points in the kiosk/room are tightened, together with the insulators and gaskets
Make sure the low- and medium-voltage copper busbars are insulated and identified to prevent moisture reaching them
Check the end boxes of the medium- and low-voltage cables
Check the low-voltage components and replace the damaged ones
Make sure the medium-voltage disconnect switches and fuses, the contact points and the ease of opening the disconnect switches are sound
Make sure the medium- and low-voltage cables are numbered and labelled
Check the height of the kiosk/room level above ground level
Make sure all cable entry openings are sealed
Make sure all medium- and low-voltage cables are buried
Make sure there is lighting inside the kiosk / room
Make sure the kiosk/room components are generally clean, using the blower
Make sure there is a maintenance card inside the kiosk/room
Make sure there is a single-line diagram for the medium and low voltage of the kiosk/room
Check the ventilation of the kiosk/room
Check the paint of the kiosk and the door and window of the room, if necessary
Make sure the medium-voltage panel is securely closed
Make sure the capacitor is reconnected
Make sure the portable earths are removed
Make sure the automatic fire-fighting system is restarted
Make sure the kiosk or room door is securely closed according to the locking means (hasp, rose, bolt with padlock, lock)
Make sure there are no obstructions around the kiosk/room
Make sure there is a danger-of-death warning sign on the outside of the kiosk/room
Make sure there is an emergency telephone numbers sticker on the outside of the kiosk/room door

Introduction
This document sets out the P1 maintenance procedures to be carried out annually, as indicated above by the code Y1. The first draft was prepared from the documents previously prepared by the Holding Company for Electric Power Distribution, and the document was discussed, amended and approved by the MPIS coordinators of the electricity distribution companies at the session of 17 March 2009
This maintenance is carried out to restore the efficiency of the transformer kiosk equipment to its normal condition; it is performed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions, if any, taking operating conditions into account, and replacing and renewing the kiosk/room components that need replacement, in order to avoid sudden faults
Safety Precautions
Issue an approved work permit and work order; maintenance staff must carry the occupational safety and health category card | 
Make sure the site is fenced off to define the work area and that warning signs are posted | 
It is essential to follow the occupational safety and health instructions and procedures, wearing the helmet and safety shoes, etc. | 
Make sure there is no voltage from the supply source, using a voltage indicator | 
Make sure the cable disconnect switches are opened and isolated from all their sources | 
Make sure there is no voltage on the cable disconnect switches | 
Make sure the kiosk is isolated from all supply sources | 
Make sure portable earths are applied to the kiosk/room components to be worked on, after making sure there is no back-fed voltage on them | 
Make sure the capacitor switch is opened and wait 15 minutes for low voltage until the charge is discharged; for medium voltage make sure the charge is discharged | 
Tools and Equipment Used
A suitable set of tools and screwdrivers fit for use
Occupational safety and health equipment (PPE) such as the helmet and safety shoes, etc.
Tested voltage indicator, set of local earths
Blower, cleaning brush and pieces of soft, clean cloth
Paint material for painting the kiosk
Cable numbering machine
Spare lighting lamps, emergency torch, lighting machine
